claim: Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 placed five Singapore bars in the top 50: Jigger & Pony (No.3), Offtrack (No.23), Nutmeg & Clove (No.24), Cat Bite Club (No.44) and Native (No.45).
quote: Jigger & Pony is crowned The Best Bar in Singapore and third in Asia – that's seven years straight of appearing in Asia's 50 Best Bars' top 10 ranking.

claim: Singapore's extended 51-100 representatives include Side Door (53), Sago House (56), Origin Bar (60), Night Hawk (77), Employees Only (89) and Fura (95).
quote: Singapore claims six places on the 51-100 list, with Side Door, a new entrant, leading the pack at No.53... Sago House at No.56, followed by Origin Bar (No.60), Night Hawk (No.77), and Employees Only (No.89), culminating with Fura at No.95.

claim: Singapore's World's 50 Best Bars 2025 entries are Jigger & Pony at No.9 and Nutmeg & Clove at No.50, with Native at No.84 on the extended list.
quote: Jigger & Pony is the best bar in Singapore, securing its spot within the top 10 at No. 9... Nutmeg & Clove also lands itself a spot on the World's 50 Best Bars 2025 list at No. 50.

claim: The Long Bar at Raffles Singapore is the birthplace of the Singapore Sling, created around 1915 by Hainanese bartender Ngiam Tong Boon.
quote: The Singapore Sling is a gin-based cocktail that was created around 1915 by a Hainanese bartender named Ngiam Tong Boon, right here at the Raffles Hotel's Long Bar.

claim: A Singapore Sling at the Long Bar costs S$39 before service charge and tax, roughly S$47 all-in.
quote: the price for a Singapore Sling at the Long Bar is S$39, before service charge and taxes. With the service charge and taxes included, this comes to approximately S$47

claim: Atlas occupies the Art Deco lobby of Parkview Square in Bugis and houses a soaring eight-metre gin tower stocked with over 1,300 labels.
quote: Atlas is located in the lobby of Parkview Square in Bugis, also known as Singapore's 'Gotham Building,' and features soaring ceilings, gleaming gold, and an iconic eight-metre gin tower

claim: Manhattan at Conrad Singapore Orchard launched its 2025 'Seasons of Manhattan' menu of 31 cocktails inspired by New York's four seasons, and houses the world's first in-hotel rickhouse.
quote: Seasons of Manhattan... presents 31 cocktails capturing the essence of Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter in New York City.

claim: Native on Amoy Street is a three-storey shophouse with a ground-floor restaurant, second-floor cocktail bar and third-floor fermentation lab, focused on regional Southeast Asian spirits and ingredients.
quote: The establishment comprises a restaurant on the first floor, a cocktail bar on the second and a fermentation lab on the third

claim: CÉ LA VI sits on the 57th floor atop Marina Bay Sands with modern Asian flavours and a SkyBar.
quote: Perched on the 57th floor of Marina Bay Sands, CÉ LA VI takes modern Asian flavours and electrifying entertainment to the highest level.

claim: LeVeL33 at Marina Bay Financial Centre is billed as the world's highest urban craft microbrewery, brewing lagers, ales, stouts and wheat beers on-site.
quote: LeVeL33 holds the title of the world's highest urban microbrewery, brewing its own lagers, ales, stouts, and wheat beers on-site at Marina Bay Financial Centre.

claim: 1-Altitude on the 63rd floor of One Raffles Place is listed as closed as of the rooftop guide's October 2025 update; 1-Group has shifted its rooftop play to 1-Altitude Coast on Sentosa.
Haw Par Villa offers free outdoor park entry (9am–8pm), but the outdoor park is closed from 8 December 2025 until further notice; only the ticketed Hell's Museum (from S$20) remains open.
quote: The park will be closed from 8 December 2025 until further notice. Not to worry, Hell's Museum is still open. Tickets to visit Hell's Museum costs from $20

claim: Sembawang Hot Spring Park is Singapore's only natural mainland hot spring, open free daily 7am–7pm with a cascading foot bath and an egg-cooking station at 70°C.
quote: Sembawang Hot Spring Park is Singapore's only hot spring park, set in a rustic, kampung-like setting.

claim: Three-hour kelong boat tours from the northeast coast visit Smith Marine, the country's first floating seafood kelong restaurant, and pass some of Singapore's last remaining stilted fish farms off Pulau Ubin.
quote: an actual visit to Smith Marine Kelong, the first Floating Seafood Restaurant in Singapore located just off the coastal waters of Pulau Ubin

claim: Singapore's 24-hour supper scene anchors on Geylang, where Yong He Eating House (458 Geylang Rd Lor 24A) is famous for mala bak kut teh, alongside 24/7 spots like 89.7 Supper Club and Kazutake Ramen.
quote: 89.7 Supper Club is open 24/7 and offers a wide variety of cuisines... Yong He Eating House at 458 Geylang Road Lor 24A, open 24/7, famous for mala bak kut teh
